title: Bounded principal neighbourhood in a coefficient model
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $n,c\in\mathbf N$ and $f_i\in R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ for $i\in\operatorname{Fin}(c)$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Suppose this specified presentation is a relative global complete intersection [def-weil-pbc-relative-global-complete-intersection]. Let $R_0\subseteq R$ be any subring and $f_{0,i}\in R_0[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ with coefficientwise images $f_i$. Write $S_0=R_0[x]/(f_0)$ and $S=R[x]/(f)$. For every prime $q$ of $S$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] there is $G\in R_0[x]$ whose image in $S$ avoids $q$, and such that every nonzero fibre of $R_0\to(S_0)_{\bar G}$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away, def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] has spectrum of topological Krull dimension at most $n-c$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. No finite-type assumption on $R_0$ is needed; $S_0$ is finite type over it.

proof.text: Use Presentation.naive(f₀).baseChange R and the equality of mapped relations to construct S ≃ R ⊗[R₀] S₀. Contract q to q₀ in S₀ and p in R, and set p₀ to the contraction of p to R₀; quotient-map commutation identifies p₀ with the contraction of q₀.

The prime q supplies a nonzero fibre at p by PrimeSpectrum.nontrivial_iff_mem_rangeComap. The presentation hypothesis gives its dimension n-c. ResidueField.map defines κ(p₀) → κ(p), and two cancelBaseChange equivalences identify this fibre with κ(p) ⊗[κ(p₀)] (p₀.Fiber S₀). The residue-field base-changed naive presentation is finite presentation, hence finite type. Apply the existing global field-extension dimension theorem and homeomorphism invariance to conclude dim Spec(p₀.Fiber S₀)=n-c.

The fibre point Q corresponding to q₀ has local dimension bounded above by the global dimension via the supremum formula. Each open neighbourhood contains Q, hence the closure of its singleton is a nonempty irreducible closed subset; Order.krullDim_nonneg shows its dimension is nonnegative. Thus the local dimension is neither bottom nor infinity and equals a natural d ≤ n-c. Apply exists_away_fibre_dimension_le at q₀ to get g avoiding q₀ with localized fibre bound d.

Lift g to G by Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective. Contraction along the explicit quotient map gives avoidance upstairs. Rewrite the localized bounds with this lift and compose the bound d with d ≤ n-c. If S=0 there is no prime q and the assertion is vacuous.

lean.statement: theorem exists_coefficient_model_principal_neighborhood (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n c : ℕ) (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (h : IsRelativeGlobalCompleteIntersectionPresentation f) (R₀ : Subring R) (f₀ : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R₀) (hf₀ : ∀ i, MvPolynomial.map R₀.subtype (f₀ i) = f i) (q : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))) : ∃ G : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R₀, Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) (MvPolynomial.map R₀.subtype G) ∉ q.asIdeal ∧ ∀ (p₀ : Ideal R₀) [p₀.IsPrime], Nontrivial (p₀.Fiber (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f₀)) G))) → topologicalKrullDim (PrimeSpectrum (p₀.Fiber (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f₀)) G)))) ≤ ((n - c : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)
